vLLM local provider routes requests via vllm/ model prefix with no auth

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "vllm/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B" });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices[0].message.content);
  console.log(result.choices[0].finishReason);
  console.log(result.model);
}

void main();
```
